notes: The 1971 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: dedications of recreation centers, mini-parks and the McLaren amphitheater, play-area designs.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Cayuga and Lyell mini-park (no page), the 22nd and Connecticut mini-park (its page has no parcel to resolve to), the Eureka Valley mini-park plan by Dan Carter (May 13; site not identified), the DAR's Azalea Garden at the Pioneer Log Cabin (letter only, no date), a Candlestick Hall of Fame drawing by John S. Bolles' office.
coverage.note: Few meeting openers survive; dated by footers and the index (Christopher dedication). Curated list F1971.py.

findings.address_as_written: Play apparatus at Bernal Park (Precita Green)
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $7,500 agreement, paid from an urban beautification grant, with Beckwith & Langsner to design, build and place play apparatus at Bernal Park, the Precita Green.
